title: Reading Transport
description: reading-buses.co.uk Reading Buses, officially Reading Transport Limited, is a municipal bus operator owned by Reading Borough Council in Berkshire, England, tracing its roots back to 1901 when the city bought the horse tramway. Now celebrating 125 years, it runs 173 buses on around 60 routes, carrying 66000 passenger journeys a day with 580 employees, making it one of Reading's largest employers. Led by CEO Robert Williams, it is famous for its colour branded routes, the flagship purple 17 between Tilehurst and Wokingham Road being the historic tram and trolleybus line. The company is an environmental leader, operating 64 plus biomethane buses, including the world's first biogas double deckers, and launching 25 battery electric Alexander Dennis Enviro400EV buses in February 2026, growing to 49 electric buses by 2027. It also owns sister firms Thames Valley Buses, Newbury and District, and Thames Valley Bodyworks, running services to Windsor, Heathrow and London.
